title: Letters, Sanger programs and organist Lorman
summary: A fan letter from Mississippi in 1923, Sanger programs, and Ed Lorman, another organist.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

But not during these years. Mm-hmm. See, see here, uh, I played there at the same time. Lorman was one of the organists that played there. I think that's his name there.
